You may search for cases by Index Number or the name of the Plaintiff or Defendant, look up cases by Attorney/Firm name, and view Calendars for each court. With our eTrack case tracking service you can receive email updates and appearance reminders for Civil Supreme Court cases. WebCivil Supreme is provided as a FREE public service by the New York State Unified Court System. Website Terms of Use This system and all data are the property of the New York State Unified Court System (UCS). Data may not be mined or sold, or used in any pay-for-use application, without the express written permission of UCS. This site may not be accessed by any automated program ("bot") for the purpose of extracting data for any use. This site may not be directly linked to by any website without the express written permission of UCS.
